items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
items.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
items.description:
Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations.

The Screen layout designer is modernized as a React-based web experience embedded in Commerce headquarters, with a JSON-based layout backbone replacing the legacy XML representation. The feature applies to Store Commerce point of sale (POS).

The modernization includes these core capabilities:

  • Visual layout and button-grid authoring: Arrange and resize supported POS components on a drag-and-drop canvas, configure properties, and edit associated button grids and POS operation mappings in a unified experience.
  • Live preview: Inspect layouts and their associated button-grid operations while designing, and preview supported device sizes and orientations without distributing every design iteration to stores.
  • Existing layout migration: Bring existing screen layouts and button-grid configurations into the modern designer rather than recreate them from scratch.
  • Reusable configuration: Reuse layout templates with store-specific overrides to reduce the need to maintain duplicate layouts.
  • Modern usability: Work with contextual properties, familiar Fluent UI controls, and inline validation.

Administrators enable or disable the modern designer through feature management in headquarters. Authorized users open Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Screen layouts, select a layout, and open the designer. They configure the layout and button grids, inspect the preview, and save changes to headquarters. Administrators distribute the saved configuration to stores through the existing Commerce data distribution process. Previewing changes does not replace the distribution needed to update Store Commerce.

Setup is performed by a Commerce administrator, who enables the feature, grants appropriate headquarters permissions, and manages layout assignments and distribution. No separate ClickOnce designer installation or Copilot license is required for manual design.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Marketing tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
items.description:
The Customer Insights plugin brings Dynamics 365 Customer Insights context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork. Marketers and other customer-facing teams can understand customer profiles, author brand-compliant content, and prepare consent-aware outreach using existing segments directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Customer Insights.

The native Customer Insights skills (Customer Brief & Value Metrics, Email Content Advisor, and Customer Outreach) invoke tools published through the Dynamics 365 MCP server to retrieve unified customer profile and journey context and to perform supported actions in Customer Insights – Journeys. These tools respect Dynamics 365 business logic and the user's existing permissions on each call. The skills are included in the Customer Insights plugin, providing administrators with a governed way to deploy and manage the capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
items.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
items.description:
We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.
Generate document from form (Preview) allows customers to create documents from a template by mapping data inputs to predefined template fields.
Documents are generated as part of an automated flow and stored in SharePoint.
This capability supports scenarios such as creating contracts, invoices, letters, or reports using structured templates and form-driven inputs.
The action works by mapping input data to template fields and returns the generated document along with file metadata such as location and status.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
items.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support for refining query filters for Confluence Copilot connectors
items.description:
This feature enhances and standardizes query filtering across both Confluence Cloud and Confluence On-premises connectors.

For Confluence Cloud connector, it introduces simplified options to filter pages by page id, creation date/time and last update date/time, helping improve productivity and reduce human errors.

For Confluence On-premises connector, it adds support for advanced CQL-based filtering, enabling more complex and flexible filtering scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Connectors, and Agents for US Government customers
items.description:
We are introducing new Microsoft 365 Copilot usage reports for Copilot Search, Copilot Connectors, and Copilot Agents for US Government customers across GCC Moderate, GCC High, and DoD environments.
These reports will provide administrators with organization-level and user-level insights to help them understand usage and adoption of these Copilot capabilities.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management – Retention for Copilot Memory
items.description: Configure retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory to help preserve historical versions of memory items for security, compliance, and investigation scenarios. Copilot memory includes saved memories and details inferred from chat history that enable more personalized and context-aware Copilot experiences. Copilot memory items are stored in a hidden folder in the user’s Exchange mailbox. This capability will enable retention and versioning support for inactive memory items so that administrators can maintain visibility into memory changes while active memory continues to be managed by the Copilot experience.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Planner: Save AI-generated filters in Planner Agent chat
items.description: Save AI-filters generated by the Planner Agent for future use on your plans.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-generated meeting memory for knowledge retention (formerly AI-generated meeting archive)
items.description: Teams will store AI-generated meeting memory files for meetings where Intelligent Recap was turned on, allowing Copilot (and Facilitator) to retain key insights from meetings beyond transcript retention periods and when a transcript was not saved. This enables Copilot to continue answering questions about past meetings even after the transcript expires or the meeting is over. Admins can also configure how long this AI-generated meeting memory file is stored.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Microsoft 365: Frontier expands to public previews in Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint
items.description: Frontier is expanding to bring eligible public preview features across Microsoft 365 into one program. Users enrolled in Frontier can get eligible previews for new Outlook for Windows, OneDrive, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Copilot, managed through a single admin-controlled enrollment experience. Frontier enrollment is optional and separate from Standard and Deferred release preferences for generally available features. Existing Frontier users do not need to re-enroll.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): [Education] Create multi-week unit plans with Teach
items.description:
Educators can use Teach in Microsoft 365 Copilot to create structured unit plans that span multiple lessons or weeks. They can customize the plan components to organize connected lesson plans and quizzes across a unit.

#education

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Federated Copilot Connectors will support write, update and delete actions
items.description: Federated Copilot connectors (MCP type) currently let Microsoft 365 Copilot read data from third-party services in real time. With this update, the connector tools that create, update, and delete content in those services are unblocked in Copilot Chat, so users can complete work without leaving Copilot. Copilot acts with the user's own account and permissions at the third-party service, and every create, update, or delete action requires the user's explicit confirmation before it runs. Admins can view each connector's read and write/delete tools in the Microsoft 365 admin center and disable connectors that don't meet their organization's policies.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
items.description: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ground Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat in Edge for Business
items.description: Get relevant answers and insights about your open browser tabs and YouTube videos directly from the Edge side pane

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Copilot studio cost controls in MAC
items.description:
We’re expanding cost management for Microsoft Copilot Studio into the Microsoft 365 admin center. This gives administrators a more centralized way to manage Copilot Credit spend across usage-based AI workloads while retaining Copilot Studio cost management capabilities in the Power Platform admin center.
With this update, administrators can bring supported Copilot Studio environments and agents under Cost Management spending policies. Resource-based policies for environments and agents are the first planned scopes, with broader user and group policy support planned for a later phase.
Furthermore, this update will introduce cost data into cost management and agent registry for AI services and agents built on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Cowork, Microsoft Copilot Studio agents).
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics foundation for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Outlook: All Accounts view (Unified Inbox) brings your email into a single inbox view
items.description: The All-Accounts view, also known as Unified Inbox, lets you see emails from multiple accounts in a single inbox view in the new Outlook for Windows, without merging your mailboxes. Each account's inbox stays separate; the view brings them together so you can triage in one place. Users can read, delete, move, archive, and mark messages across accounts without switching between mailboxes. The experience integrates with Copilot for AI-assisted email workflows and supports Immersive Search for finding messages across your primary account. Advanced scenarios such as cross-account search and shared mailbox support will follow in later releases.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in Outlook expands to reason over inbox, calendar, and enterprise data
items.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook expanding to support reasoning over a user's entire inbox, calendar and other enterprise data for Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat users (without a Microsoft 365 Copilot license) .

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Use bullseye routing with user groups to orchestrate conversations
items.description:
Bullseye routing with user groups enables a tiered assignment strategy that automatically expands the pool of eligible representatives as conversation wait time increases. Rather than assigning from a fixed pool or waiting for overflow rules to trigger, this approach progressively widens availability in concentric rings—starting with the best-fit representatives and expanding outward as needed.

Administrators configure this scenario by associating user groups with a queue and defining wait time thresholds for each tier. For example:

  • 0–30 seconds: Assign to Tier 1 specialists (primary user group)
  • 30–60 seconds: Expand to include Tier 2 representatives (secondary user group)
  • 60+ seconds: Include all available representatives (tertiary user group)

Conversation orchestration monitors each conversation's wait time and automatically expands the eligible pool when thresholds are reached. This process ensures that customers are matched with the most qualified available representative, while preventing excessive wait times when the primary pool is at capacity.

Key benefits:

  • Best-fit first: Prioritizes the most qualified representatives before expanding to broader pools.
  • Automatic expansion: No manual intervention required—wait time thresholds trigger expansion automatically.
  • Configurable tiers: Define as many user group tiers as needed, with custom wait time thresholds for each.
  • Seamless integration: Works alongside other conversation orchestration scenarios like dynamic priority escalation and overflow based on representative availability.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Shared analytics for historical reporting
items.description: Dynamics 365 Customer Service provides out-of-the-box historical reporting built on a shared analytics foundation: a scalable, open, and AI-ready data foundation for Customer Experience and AI analytics scenarios across Dynamics 365. It uses a lakehouse-based architecture that can scale with data volume, supports curated analytics datasets for direct querying, and enables consistent reporting and semantic definitions across reports, agents, and copilots.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Sharing amongst makers
items.description: Enables sharing of agents with other makers in the new Microsoft Copilot harness. Makers can grant other makers Agent Viewer (view analytics/evaluations only) or Editor (view, edit, configure, share, publish) access to an agent, with auto-assigned security roles.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft 365 Admin Center: Usage reports - Message consumption for Pay-as-you-go experiences in Copilot Chat.
items.description: A new report to help IT admins manage costs for billed messages that are Pay-as-you-go enabled for Copilot Chat. Reporting includes drill down of billed messages per user, per billing policy, per agent-level and agent-user level pair. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on Microsoft Copilot Harness
items.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

items.title: Power Automate: AI-assisted UI Automation repair
items.description: A new agentic debug run feature will be available in the flow designer. The UI automation repair interface launches while the flow is running, validating each selector used in the flow. It then proposes a new selector in case an existing one does not work as expected, after the user captures the respective element for reference.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot app mode handoffs
items.description: The Chat experience in the Copilot app will suggest a better-fit mode based on the user's prompt, if applicable. For example, it will suggest Cowork or other supported modes as they become available. Users will see a suggestion card after they send a prompt in Chat, with an explanation of the better-fit mode and an option for the user to switch to the suggested mode. Their chat conversation will be attached to the prompt in the new mode to maintain context.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Insights and Copilot Analytics in DoD
items.description: Microsoft Viva Insights and Copilot Analytics are coming to the Microsoft 365 Department of Defense (DoD) environment, providing eligible organizations with privacy-protected, role-based analytics experiences to help them understand Microsoft 365 Copilot adoption, usage, and impact. Viva Insights also provides data-driven behavioral insights into how employees collaborate, helping organizations improve productivity and wellbeing within the DoD environment.

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.description: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Copilot Chat for chats, channels, calls, and meetings in GCC, GCC High, and DoD
items.description: Copilot Chat will soon be available across chats, channels, calls, and meetings, helping users stay informed and catch up quickly.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.description: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Agent 365 agents within Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat and Declarative Agents
items.description: Agents that are published to Agents 365 are already managed in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. If the agent implements the Agent2Agent protocol, it can be used as a connected agent for the agents that users build in Agent Builder or Copilot Studio.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Search Helps You Discover People
items.description: Now Copilot Search can return matching people for your broader people search queries. Allowing you to discover, disambiguate, and explore known and new people to contact. Discover Whether you're looking for people with a specific skill like "Project leadership" or "Artificial Intelligence" Copilot Search can help you explore potential contacts through the People data source. Disambiguate When there are multiple people matching in exact name, email, or alias Copilot Search will help you disambiguate through a new carousel on the main results page alongside other relevant results.

items.title: Excel: Get and transform data with Copilot in Excel
items.description: Get your data ready, just by asking. Describe the data you need and how you want it prepared, and the new get data skill handles the rest. It can connect and transform your data, then load the results into your workbook using Power Query, giving you a query you can inspect, edit, and refresh without having to build it yourself. Depending on the data source, authentication may be required.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): App Blocks
items.description: App Blocks enables M365 Copilot Chat users to turn their requests and data into rich, interactive experiences directly within the conversation, including calculators, dashboards, forms, planners, visualizations, simulations, comparison tools, and other interactive apps. It helps users move beyond static responses to explore data, adjust inputs, visualize outcomes, and simulate workflows in place, while supporting grounded scenarios where current information can be retrieved and then rendered into an interactive experience.

items.title: Excel: Edit with Copilot in Excel on iPhone
items.description: Edit with Copilot makes it easier to edit and transform your Excel workbooks on your phone using natural language. Copilot can continue working on your task even when you move away from the app, so you can come back when the work is ready. Chat mode also remains available when you want to ask questions and get insights without making changes to your workbook.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): SharePoint Site Builder
items.description: This feature enables users to easily create new SharePoint sites with Copilot. Users can review and confirm a clear site plan before Copilot builds the site.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.description: The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Identifiable Export metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export Identifiable row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis. This capability can be tuned On by Admins in a tenant.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Structured Document Generation with Forms
items.description: Structured Document Generation with Forms enables organizations to create, manage, and generate standardized documents at scale with built-in governance and compliance in SharePoint. Business process owners can centrally build and maintain form-driven templates -- such as contracts, agreements, proposals, and HR documents -- ensuring content stays accurate and up to date. Users can then generate the right document every time by just filling out the form, without manual formatting, versioning issues, or compliance risk, simplifying high-volume, structured document workflows across the organization.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.description: Rewrite by Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Rewrite is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge. Updated March 20, 2026: We have paused release of this feature temporarily and will announce new release timelines soon. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use overflow actions to protect customer experience for direct inward calls
items.description:
Overflow for direct inward dialing leverages conversation orchestration to detect key direct inward dialing-related events—such as the representative being busy, offline, rejecting the call, or failing to answer—and apply administrator-defined fallback actions.

Administrators configure natural language playbooks using conversation orchestration at the global or inbound profile level to specify the action to run when a direct inward dialed call can't be attended to or completed. The actions include offering a direct callback to the caller, sending them to voicemail, transferring the call to another queue or external number, or ending the call.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Personalize outreach emails generated by Sales Qualification Agent
items.description:
• Define outreach scenario/goal in natural language.
  • Choose desired call-to-action to drive next steps.
  • Provide subject line guidance: fixed suggestion or style recommendation.
  • Set message length and brevity targets.
  • Specify tone rules, including name-usage limits and preferred terminology.
  • Configure brand language and voice guardrails: approved phrases and banned words.
  • Set formatting preferences: bullets, paragraph length, and maximum bullet count.

Business Value:

This feature expands the Sales Qualification Agent outreach by letting teams define the outreach purpose, brand-aligned tone (matching both company voice and seller style), the call-to-action, and key messaging preferences proven to resonate with prospects. The result is more relevant, consistent communication that drives higher response rates and, in turn, improves lead qualification rates.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Lead management - Deploy multiple Sales Qualification Agents in a single environment
items.description:
• Segment-specific qualification: Each agent operates with its own ideal customer profile, knowledge sources, templates, and consent settings, ensuring qualification conversations reflect the nuances of each product, region, or team.
  • Intelligent lead routing: The system evaluates incoming leads against agent selection criteria and assigns ownership based on configured priority, ensuring predictable and conflict-free lead management. A fallback agent handles leads that don't match any specialized criteria, ensuring no lead goes unprocessed.
  • Exclusive engagement with coordinated handoff: Only one agent engages a lead at any time. When a lead's interest shifts to another product or segment, the system hands off with full context to the appropriate agent.
  • Shared knowledge foundation: Agents can leverage common company-level knowledge while maintaining their own specialized sources, ensuring consistent answers across the organization.
  • Supervisor oversight and governance: A centralized dashboard enables supervisors to monitor agent activity, reassign leads, and track the full qualification journey across all agents.

Business Value:

Multi-agent configuration in Sales Qualification Agents enables sales organizations to deploy agents aligned to distinct product lines, regions, or sales teams, each with its own qualification criteria, knowledge sources, and engagement approach. Multi-agent configuration ensures exclusive lead ownership, coordinates handoffs when context shifts, and provides sales managers with visibility across agents. This targeted approach mirrors real-world sales structures, eliminates duplicate outreach, accelerates qualification, and scales coverage without additional seller headcount.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Modify and override submitted evaluations
items.description:
This feature enables Quality Managers to edit and override evaluation results even after they are marked as completed or expired. While completed evaluations remain read-only by default to preserve integrity, supervisors can initiate an Edit action when discrepancies are identified, such as incorrect AI predictions or errors in manual assessments.

In edit mode, supervisors can update evaluation responses, adjust scores, and refine comments to reflect an accurate assessment. This ensures that evaluation records represent the final, validated view of agent performance and interaction quality. The capability is available across AI-assisted, AI agent-generated, and manual evaluations, providing a consistent correction experience.

To maintain control and governance, only authorized users with supervisory permissions can perform overrides. All changes are tracked through audit signals, including who made the edit and when, and overridden evaluations are clearly flagged. This ensures full transparency for reporting, compliance, and downstream reviews.

Business Value:

Enables Quality Managers or users with privileges to correct completed evaluations when inaccuracies arise from AI predictions or human review errors. This ensures evaluation outcomes accurately reflect real-world context and business standards. By introducing controlled human-in-the-loop oversight with full auditability, organizations can confidently scale automated and manual evaluations while maintaining trust, transparency, and governance.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: IVR capabilities - Equip voice agents with custom voice
items.description:
Secure a voice talent that will represent the voice of your brand. After obtaining explicit consent, gaining Limited Access approval through Microsoft's Responsible AI practices, and building a custom voice model, it's time to integrate with Dynamics 365 Contact Center.

In the Copilot Service admin center, create a connection between Dynamics 365 and Azure. Navigate to Channels > Custom AI Voices > Connect custom voice. You'll be prompted through a series of cascading dropdown boxes to select the speech resource and custom voice model to connect with. After the connection is established, you can create a voice channel for self-service and use the custom voice, like any portfolio voice.

Business Value:

Brand identity extends beyond visuals like logo, color, and typography, into voice. Custom neural voice enables enterprises to create a distinctive, natural sounding synthetic voice for contact centers. By training on approved human speech samples, organizations can deliver a natural sounding, one-of-a-kind brand voice that preserves brand continuity, strengthens customer recognition, and elevates voice-based experiences across AI-powered agents and telephony interactions.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Envision and design AI agents in Business Central
items.description:
AI agents in Business Central

Business Central introduces AI agents to help users automate repetitive tasks and make business processes more intelligent and efficient. These agents act as specialized assistants that understand context, handle structured data, and collaborate with users to complete end-to-end workflows. For example, the Sales Order Agent simplifies order creation by transforming natural language or email instructions into complete sales documents, while the Payables Agent streamlines vendor invoice processing by extracting key details from incoming invoices and matching them to purchase orders—all reducing manual effort and freeing users to focus on higher-value work.

The agent runtime that powers these built-in agents provides core capabilities that enable the use of agentic AI within Business Central. AI agents are defined, configured, activated, and run directly inside the familiar Business Central environment—leveraging the same security model, administration tools, and user experience as the rest of the product. Results are displayed in-context, with intuitive navigation to related data and entities, allowing users to control the agents through the interface they already know. This consistency dramatically reduces the learning curve, builds trust, and ensures efficiency when working with AI agents.

The agent runtime ensures that every step taken by an agent is traceable and operates strictly within the access boundaries (permissions) assigned during configuration. It provides a timeline view of all agent activities, allowing users to review what happened and why—enabling a true human-in-the-loop experience. The runtime can also memorize relevant data during execution, use it in subsequent steps, and request additional instructions in natural language when user input is needed. It helps ensure that sensitive operations always require explicit user review and consent, supporting full transparency and control.

Business Central business processes are inherently multistep, stateful, and financially consequential. The agent layer must be able to interact with a broad set of ERP capabilities and data, sequence operations with a high degree of accuracy across dependent steps, handle the data respecting permissions, company, environment, and tenant boundaries, provide a contextual audit trail, and keep humans in the loop.

Business Central agentic strategy intentionally separates deep, well controlled, in-context and transparent execution within the product from cross-system orchestration. Business Central agents form the foundational layer inside the product, exposing well-defined agent capabilities that in the future will be possible to surface as MCP tools and consume by Declarative Agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365. This layered approach enables Business Central-tuned, transparent, managed execution at the ERP core processes, while allowing higher-level Declarative Agents to orchestrate end-to-end business processes across products.

Designing agents

The new in-product experience for designing agents that automate Business Central processes is made available with AI Development Toolkit for Business Central. The experience offers a low-risk environment for envisioning and prototyping new AI agents tailored to your own business scenarios—extending the same agent runtime capabilities used by built-in Business Central agents.

Built for rapid iteration, the designing experience lets you create and refine custom agents using natural language instructions, define their behavior, test agent profiles and permissions, and safely experiment with Business Central data in a sandbox environment. This approach empowers partner personas like consultants, product owners, and domain experts, as well as developers and even power users, to explore new scenarios, validate ideas, and build confidence in their agents before moving to production. Whether you aim to automate repetitive business processes, streamline data processing, or deliver proactive insights, the agent design experience gives you the tools to bring your vision to life.

Agent instructions

At the core of every agent are its goals and instructions, defined in natural language. Writing agent instructions is similar to writing prompts for large language models, so you can apply general prompt-writing best practices—and even use tools like Copilot to optimize them. The agent design experience includes a simple editor to help you define, refine, and test these instructions efficiently.

Invoking your agent

You can invoke your agent by manually creating a task for it. When doing so, you can include an additional message that provides specific details or context to complement the agent’s core instructions. Although the ability to design your own agents is in public preview, there aren't yet any built-in integrations to automatically trigger these custom agents based on incoming emails, events, or scheduled recurrences (this can be done by professional developers using the APIs available in the AI Development Toolkit). However, you can simulate these scenarios by including the email header and body in the task message to mimic incoming emails, or by manually triggering the agent to emulate event, UI action, or time-based runs.

Troubleshooting

When running the agent tasks in the designing experience, you can access detailed diagnostic views to help you understand and tune the agent execution. Since an agent’s decisions depend on its instructions, available data, and language model reasoning, you can review execution logs to see its inputs, reasoning process, and outputs. This helps you identify where uncertainty occurred and why specific decisions were made to adjust your agent instructions.

Importing and exporting agents

To make it easy to back up or move custom agents across sandbox environments, the in-product experience allows you to import and export agent definitions. These definitions are stored as simple JSON files containing properties such as agent identity, instructions, assigned profiles, and permissions. We recommend storing these files in a source control system like GitHub to track changes and maintain version history.

Responsible AI

Agents built using the agent design experience adhere to Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, helping you ensure agent compliance, fairness, and safety.

Billing

As with the built-in Sales Order and Payables agents, custom agents consume Copilot credits as they perform their steps. Credits can be provisioned through prepaid or pay-as-you-go models, providing flexible cost management as your AI usage scales.

Business Value:

Agents in Business Central are AI-powered team assistants that go beyond traditional automation. Unlike static workflows or hard-coded AL logic, agents can interpret high-level business goals expressed in natural language and translate them into actionable steps. They reason over Business Central data, make informed decisions within defined boundaries, and collaborate with users through human-in-the-loop approvals for critical operations.

The benefits are substantial: agents reduce manual effort by automating repetitive or complex tasks, allowing users to focus on higher-value activities. They adapt to dynamic business scenarios that can't always be anticipated during development, offering flexibility that traditional automation lacks. Most importantly, agents operate transparently: every action is logged, permissions are rigorously enforced, and users remain in control at all times.

This combination of intelligence, adaptability, and accountability makes agents a cornerstone of the next generation of ERP experiences. With the agent design experience, we're taking the first steps toward enabling you to build your own custom Business Central agents.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Enforce governance policy
items.description:
Create and enforce policies that prevent risky or noncompliant customer communications.

Governance policy checks serve as configurable safeguards that review AI-generated and autonomous email responses before they are sent to customers. These checks enforce business, legal, and regulatory requirements by validating responses for relevance, prohibited content, and sensitive topics. If a response fails a policy check, delivery is blocked and the violation is clearly identified, enabling supervisors to review issues and take actions to improve outcomes.

Governance policies are applied consistently across email engagement channels and seamlessly embedded within agent workflows, ensuring uniform enforcement of quality and compliance standards without requiring manual intervention. This approach empowers organizations to scale AI-assisted and autonomous customer engagement with confidence while upholding trust, safety, and governance.

Business Value:

Governance policies give you control over AI-driven customer interactions. By setting clear, configurable rules, you make sure every response meets your business, legal, and regulatory standards before it reaches customers. This reduces risk, protects your brand, and keeps communication consistent and trustworthy.

Enabled for:

Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Run multiple Sales Order Agents per company with smarter item matching, relevance filtering, and streamlined setup
items.description:
You can now configure and run multiple Sales Order Agent instances in a single company. Each instance operates independently with its own mailbox, folder settings, email signature, and processing rules.

Each agent instance tracks its own KPI metrics, such as emails received, quotes created, orders created, and time saved. The setup page is restructured to support per-instance configuration, and an upgrade path migrates existing single-instance setups to the new architecture. This change allows organizations to set up separate agents for different sales teams, product lines, or customer segments, each monitoring their own personal or shared mailbox.

Improved items search:

When a customer requests items, the agent now uses a multi-layer matching strategy:

  • Exact identifier match: direct lookup by item number, vendor item number, GTIN, or cross-reference.
  • Semantic attribute matching: extracts attributes from the customer's message (color, material, size) and ranks candidates by relevance using AI.
  • Broader fuzzy search: falls back to a global item search when direct and attribute-based searches produce no results.

Message and attachment relevance:

The agent now validates incoming messages and attachments against a detailed relevance model before processing. Messages that fall outside the agent's responsibilities (such as offers to sell, requests for discounts, or attempts to extract internal information) are identified and filtered.

A separate relevance check runs on attachments, ensuring that non-sales-related documents don't trigger unnecessary processing. The validation considers the full conversation history and the agent's defined scope to make accurate relevance decisions.

Larger attachment files with diagnostics.

The maximum number of pages per PDF attachment has been raised from 10 to 50, addressing customer feedback about the agent not reading larger purchase orders. A new cumulative content length limit of 150,000 characters is also enforced across all attachments in a single email (approximately 50K tokens).

When an attachment is skipped, Business Central now stores the specific reason directly on the attachment record (page count exceeded, cumulative content length exceeded, attachment count exceeded, unsupported format, or analyze-attachments not enabled). This information is visible on the Attachments page and logged in telemetry, making it straightforward to diagnose why a particular document wasn't processed.

Try it out.

You can now create tasks for the Sales Order Agent without sending an email. From the agent's setup page, a new Try it out section lets you compose a message by selecting a sender (from your contact or customer list), entering message text, and attaching files. The agent acts like it received a real email.

To help you get started quickly, two sample messages are included. One is a text-only message that references items from your catalog, and the other is a message with a sample purchase order attachment. The sample order is generated based on your actual item data, so the agent has realistic content to work with.

These samples are particularly useful for first-time setup, demos, and testing agent behavior with specific scenarios without needing to send an actual email.

Handling of unknown senders

When the agent receives an email from an unregistered email address, you now have three options instead of just one:

  • Create a new contact: register the sender as a new contact (existing behavior)
  • Use another contact once: pick an existing contact from the contact list and link them to this specific task only, without modifying any master data. The override is stored per task message and does not affect future emails.
  • Update an existing contact's email: select an existing contact and update their email address to the sender's address

More control over email

New configuration options give administrators more control over how the agent interacts with the monitored mailbox:

  • Mark email as read: a new toggle to mark processed emails as read in the mailbox. This works in addition to the custom Processed by Sales Order Agent category, giving users a visual signal in their inbox.
  • Mandatory folder selection: the agent now requires you to select a specific mailbox folder before activation. Previously this was optional and could lead to the agent monitoring an unexpected folder. If in doubt, choose Inbox.
  • Stricter activation validation: trying to activate the agent without a mailbox folder now shows a clear error message instead of allowing activation in an ambiguous state.

Prompts as embedded resources.

The agent's AI prompts (instructions, item search logic, mail template checks, irrelevance validation) are now shipped as embedded resource files within the app extension package. This change reduces latency on first task processing and makes the prompt structure more transparent for engineering iteration.

Business Value:

The Sales Order Agent now handles more complex organizational structures and higher volumes with less manual intervention. You can run multiple agent instances in one company, each dedicated to a different team or shared mailbox with independent settings and performance tracking. The agent finds the right items more reliably by understanding product attributes, informal descriptions, and identifiers across multiple matching layers.
The agent now processes PDFs up to 50 pages (previously, the limit was 10) and clearly shows why any attachment was skipped. It also filters irrelevant messages before processing, so credits aren't consumed by marketing emails or out-of-scope inquiries. If a customer writes from an unregistered email address, you can link an existing contact to that single task without creating duplicates. You can test the agent directly from the setup page without sending a real email, reducing the time to validate your configuration.

Enabled for:

Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Resolve customer emails autonomously with AI
items.description:
Autonomous email resolution delivers end-to-end handling of customer emails without manual intervention or default case creation. When an email arrives, the system analyzes the request, identifies the underlying intent, and determines whether the information and actions needed to resolve it are available.

Using enterprise knowledge, configured business instructions, connectors, and custom agents, the system constructs a resolution dynamically. It generates a response that's context-aware, compliant with business rules, and tailored to the request, then delivers it directly by email—completing the interaction autonomously.

If the customer isn't satisfied or the issue can't be resolved automatically, the system creates a case that carries the full conversation context, including customer intent, actions taken, and generated responses. A service representative can then step in without losing context or duplicating work.

The capability is delivered through the Case Management Agent. An administrator enables the setting and sets the automation level for each line of business, from fully autonomous resolution to drafting a response for a service representative to review and send.

This shifts email handling from a case-first workflow to an intent-driven resolution model, reducing manual effort, improving consistency, and accelerating time to resolution for high-volume customer interactions.

Business Value:

Autonomous email resolution drives faster, consistent responses and frees service representatives to focus on complex, high-impact issues. It improves customer satisfaction and operational efficiency and scales support without increasing response times and costs by automatically resolving high-volume email inquiries.

items.title: Power Pages: Plugin support for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code to create and edit traditional sites
items.description: The Power Pages plugin for GitHub Copilot CLI and Claude Code now supports creating and editing traditional (non-SPA) Power Pages sites. Developers can use natural-language prompts in their AI coding agent to create a new traditional site or download, inspect, and update existing site metadata such as web pages, web templates, content snippets, basic and multistep forms, lists, table permissions, web roles, and site settings, then upload changes back to their environment using the Power Platform CLI.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator in GCC
items.description: Facilitator is coming to Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC. The Facilitator agent can help capture notes in real time, answers questions about the meeting, and help keep the agenda and discussion on track. A Microsoft 365 Copilot license is required to use Facilitator.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): JPG and PNG references in Copilot Notebooks
items.description: Copilot Notebooks now supports JPG and PNG files as knowledge sources, allowing users to bring images directly into their projects alongside traditional documents. Copilot can use the content within these images, including text, charts, diagrams, and other visuals, as grounding context to help generate more relevant presentations, reports, and briefs.
